exceptional_cases: No positivity hypothesis on the sequence is added.
R-admissible.trust_boundary: Pinned provider definition bytes; eventual quantifier and normalization retained.

hypotheses: A proof h of the exact root proposition.

R-root.inference: Compose source-to-target with target-to-source at the exact root.

exceptional_cases: Worker result is provisional and does not set Master acceptance.
